original_target.title: Do dihedral angles determine a convex hyperbolic polyhedron globally?

full_original_statement: Let $`P`$ and $`Q`$ be compact convex polyhedra in hyperbolic three-space $`\mathbb H^3`$ with the same combinatorial type. Suppose every edge of $`P`$ has the same dihedral angle as the corresponding edge of $`Q`$. **Must $`P`$ and $`Q`$ be congruent by a hyperbolic isometry?** A pair of noncongruent polyhedra satisfying these conditions would settle the question negatively.
